newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gandel appoints Centro md Appleton.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gandel appoints Centro md Appleton.

text.p: Gandel Retail Trust said on Monday that Clive Appleton had been appointed managing director of Gandel Management Ltd and chief executive officer, retail property, of the Gandel Group.
Gandel Management is the manager of the trust.

Appleton, currently the chief executive officer of property investor Centro Properties Ltd, would take up his position in December this year, Gandel said. Centro said Appleton would remain with the company for up to three months to ensure the completion of some projects and a smooth transition. It did not name a replacement. --Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
